milestone: OPS-DISCOVERY-P3R-S2B provenance-safe source snapshot execution contract
scope: execution provenance only; no source snapshot or population reproduction executed

run_id.generation: UTC creation timestamp plus cryptographically random 128-bit hexadecimal suffix
run_id.collision_rule: atomic creation of a run-scoped namespace; pre-existing namespace returns HOLD_PROVENANCE_ERROR and is never changed

legacy_quarantine.rule: never consume, promote, repair, overwrite, rename, or delete legacy artifacts; future runs use distinct namespaces

ownership.single_writer_enforcement: one namespace per run ID; namespace collision fails closed before child launch

lifecycle_binding.pid_reuse_protection: PID is never an ownership key; the immutable run ID, atomic namespace claim, runner hash, command, and recorded child-start time bind the process to artifacts

promotion: only wrapper promotion after runner audit status COMPLETE, replay_identical=true, and child exit code=0; all HOLD temporary outputs remain non-authoritative and non-reusable
interruption: wrapper writes STARTED before child launch; missing terminal audit or child error produces a terminal HOLD where possible; a namespace without terminal lifecycle remains non-authoritative and collision-protected for later investigation

coverage: run ID propagation and lifecycle attribution
interrupted terminal HOLD retains non-authoritative temporary output

next_authorization_required: Separately authorize either one fresh provenance-safe source snapshot under the unchanged 300-second bound, or analysis of whether the unchanged implementation can legitimately complete within that bound.
